findings.description: WoW Edit Mode UI layout exports are long whitespace-separated numeric/frame records beginning with a version header (e.g. 2 50), not base64 CDM strings. Source language audit could treat them as prose or discard adjacent evidence through length guards.
findings.fix: Ignore whole cells matching a conservative export header, multiple frame references and repeated layout delimiters. Keep ordinary prose and short code-like fragments.
